name: Hank Szramkowski
background: Hank Szramkowski ran as the Democratic nominee for House District 6 in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Douglas mailing address. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the filings and local coverage reviewed for this Profile.
